entities.summary: Olena Yuriyivna Iurkovska is a cross-country skier and biathlete from Ukraine, and a five time Paralympic Champion. She has won a total of five gold, five silver, and five bronze medals up to 2010 in the Winter Paralympics. She also competed at the 2004 Summer Paralympics, as a member of the Ukrainian volleyball team.
